title: Prometheus chained in the Caucasus by Zeus

tellings.quote: Prometheus is punished by Zeus, right? And chained in the Caucasus and has his liver devoured.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a researcher and writer named Jason Jorjani retells the Greek myth of Prometheus, a figure punished by Zeus, king of the gods. As he tells it, Prometheus was chained in the Caucasus mountains and had his liver devoured. Jorjani uses the myth as part of his wider argument about ancient stories and hidden knowledge.
